oracle.engine: dss_capi 0.15.0b4 (OpenDSS SVN r4103); regenerated for WP-U1.6 D12 (SwtControl Normal/State field mapping). The `swtcontrol_locked_then_action` scenario was dropped: capi015 raises the strict PermissiveProperties read-only error (#2024106) on a locked `Action=` write, which the port deliberately does NOT adopt (ledger L2 / C2 dss-ext-only surface) — it silently ignores, unit-pinned by `locked_ignores_action_write` / `locked_ignores_normal_and_state_writes`.
